_readme: The Timeline (timeline.html). Events are listed in the order they HAPPENED (in-universe). 'line' is where the MASTER FILE tells it (content/book.txt), which gives the 'As told' order. Text uses the same [[slug|label]] markup as the articles. Run python3 build/build.py after editing.

lanes.name: Scott the Woz & the Wii cube

eras.name: Before time: the Cycle of Chris
eras.blurb: The first 303 lines of the MASTER FILE tell this story eight times, almost word for word. The Wiki tells it once. You can go round again as many times as you like.

eras.name: Ancient times
eras.blurb: The Cycle breaks the only way it can: with a stabbing. No dates survive from this era. Neither do reasons.

eras.name: Recorded history
eras.blurb: The part of the timeline with actual years in it. Some of them are even real.

eras.name: Not long before the story
eras.blurb: Undated, but recent enough that people still bring it up at the worst possible moment.

eras.name: Centuries later: the story
eras.blurb: Fast forward enough centuries for humans to do surgery on a grape. From here on the Timeline follows the book, except where the book doesn't.

events.title: Chris is a baby, is baller, dies, and becomes the ball
events.text: [[chris|Chris]] was a baby. He was baller. Then he died, then he [[balling|balled]] from the grave, then he became [[the-ball|the ball]] and balled himself into the sky together with [[lebron-james|LeBron James]], [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] to learn the [[social-media-teachings|secret teachings]] of Twitter, MySpace, Instagram, Snapchat and, Facebook.

quote.text: Why do we believe what we believe we believe that we believe we believe we believe. Its a matter of Chris.

events.title: Apple Podcasts is founded
events.text: Together the four of them form a new social media platform called [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]], and spread the word of Chris to all the [[middle-aged-men|middle-aged men]] who roam the earth.

events.title: Elon Mush mooshes the chalkboards and creates Settings
events.text: Elon Musk's secret cousin [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] mooshes all the [[chalkboards]] on earth and uses their power to create the anti-social media platform [[settings|Settings]]: a place for computer nerds to tweak their settings on all devices until the ends of all times.

events.title: Elon Mush creates the multiverse
events.text: Mush creates the [[multiverse]] so that he can recreate *Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse*. While he is at it he accidentally creates the [[cringe-universe|Cringe Universe]].

events.title: The Dabbing of the Haters
events.text: [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] sees the Cringe Universe and sends the [[baller-army|Baller Army of the United States of A America]] to dab on the haters. This attack is a hard one: over 10 casualties are found, and every hater is dabbed on.

quote.text: nah bro thats cringe

events.title: The Great Oppression
events.text: The [[america-universe|America Universe]] takes over the Cringe Universe.

events.title: Two more universes, then a civil war
events.text: America yearns for the [[minor-miner-universe|Minor Miner Universe]] because it is funny. Together with Elon Musk it takes over over 2 universes, after which a [[multiverse-civil-war|civil war]] breaks out. The bad ones win.

events.title: Zuckerberg's Snap
events.text: [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] snaps his fingers, and every universe except his favourite is sent to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]], a realm where light doesn't exist.

events.title: Frodo cooks the universe
events.text: [[frodo|Frodo]] appears deep in the universe, starts a galactic takeover of the [[andromeda-galaxy|Andromeda Galaxy]] and uses [[master-chef|Master Chef]] to cook the universe into a sirloin steak with lobster tail. He eats it and leaves the face of the universe, never to be baller again.

events.title: The Great Famine
events.text: There is no universe left to eat. [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] dies of [[nfl-poisoning|NFL poisoning]].

events.title: The Merging
events.text: [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] merges with [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] to become [[samwise|Samwise]].

events.title: Samwise creates Chris, who is born in Newark
events.text: And then Chris was a baby, and he was baller, and the whole thing happens again. The MASTER FILE goes round eight times before anything else is allowed to happen.

events.title: The Stabbing of Chris
events.text: [[ron-desantis|Ron DeSantis]] stabs Chris to death, claiming he was gay because he was a homo-sapien. It is the first thing in the canon that is not the Cycle. The book tells it twice: halfway through the Cycle, and again as the first line of Chapter 2.

events.title: The Quest for the 73 Taco Bell Locations begins
events.text: Destined for glory by the hands of [[trumpy-the-red|Trumpy the Red]], DeSantis sets out to find the 73 Taco Bell locations. The quest is ongoing.

events.title: The IMDb review bomb
events.text: Trumpy, a third party in the universe, advocates for [[truth-social|Truth Social]] to be the best social media platform above them all. However, [[the-redditor|a redditor]] leaves a 0.5 score on [[imdb|IMDb]], and it is review-bombed by [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]], the Roman emperor of [[canada|Canada]].

events.title: Ron refuses to make Julian the native bird
events.text: Joeius forces Ron to make [[julian|Julian]] the native bird of the [[island-of-logic-and-retoric|Island of Logic and Retoric]]. Ron says no.

events.title: The War for Byzantine Mexico
events.text: Ron turns to Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk to take back the [[byzantine-empire-of-mexico|Byzantine Empire of Mexico]]. The war is long and hard. For 0.0836 seconds in the middle of it, an [[ethereal-green-dot|ethereal green dot]] exists. Meanwhile Truth Social is booming in the [[soviet-union-of-north-korea|Soviet Union of North Korea]], which is merging with the [[democratic-republic-of-the-chinese|Democratic Republic of the Chinese]].

events.title: Medea interrupts the war
events.text: [[medea|Medea]], from the hit play *Medea*, appears out of her [[medeas-tesseract|four-dimensional tesseract dimension ship]]. Outraged, Mark Zuckerberg summons [[jason|Jason]] from the same play, who allows all his descendants and crushes ever to be killed.

quote.text: ha women

events.title: The Donkey Kong Racing Duel
events.text: Jason duels Medea in the hit video game Donkey Kong Racing. The loser must find [[mic-q|Mic Q]], who never has, never will, and cannot exist in any universe, much like [[dwayne-the-rock-johnson|Dwayne the Rock Johnson]]. Jason loses, but makes Medea look for Mic Q anyway. Medea is never seen again.

events.title: Zarkmuckerberg retires
events.text: [[zarkmuckerberg|Zarkmuckerberg]] retires at age 3 because of will to live cancer. Mark Zuckerberg does not know about this, and the event is completely irrelevant to his life story.

events.title: Chris's war crimes and the cloning
events.text: After his [[chris-war-crimes|war crimes]] in the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]], Chris's body is cloned and thrown into [[the-endless-pit|a pit thought to have no end]]. His soul stays in the first body, because the [[all-knowing-overseers|all-knowing overseers]] declare it the less wack one. So there is only one Chris.

quote.text: Baller, so theres only one then?

events.title: Steve Jobs and Wozniak start the Inav
events.text: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] and [[steve-wozniak|Wozniak]] start their biggest project yet: the [[inav|Inav]], a universal navigator and transporter for the newly found multiverse, contracted by the [[department-of-awesomeness|Department of Awesomeness]] (DOA). It is why Apple hit its slump.

events.title: The Department of Awesomeness is dissolved
events.text: The DOA is dissolved on the same day it asks for the Inav, and never uses it. Apple keeps developing it anyway.

events.title: Operation Desert Storm airs on Cartoon Network
events.text: The last time [[rfk|RFK]] hears the name Chris, until Plankton says it again.

quote.text: I haven’t heard that name since operation desert storm aired on cartoon network

events.title: The McDonald's Wine Brewing Contest
events.text: The Italian city of [[moscow|Moscow]] hosts the September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing Contest, and is wrapped in controversy for it.

events.title: The DQ–McDonald's MySpace Beef
events.text: [[dairy-queen|DQ]] starts beef with [[mcdonalds|McDonald's]] on [[myspace|MySpace]] over the contest. The [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]] rate it C tier, which they find unacceptable.

events.title: The housing market crashes, and Chris is lost
events.text: After the crash of the housing market in 2007/2008, nobody can locate Chris. The canon allows both years.

events.title: Work on the Inav ends
events.text: Apple develops the Inav until 2008. Only one exists, and it only answers to Steve Jobs.

events.title: The iPhone 3G Keynote
events.text: On a levitating stage in the [[shadow-filtered-theater|Shadow-Filtered Theater]], Cupertino, [[reality-42-b|Reality 42-B]], Steve Jobs introduces the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]]. It is sideways. It is cracked. It plays U2 on loop. It is the only phone that can run the [[sacred-apps|sacred apps]], and it connects to only one tower: [[gods-router|God's router]]. Everyone weeps.

quote.text: Good evening… or good dimension.

events.title: Siri explains how to defeat Chris
events.text: Jobs asks [[siri|Siri 3G]] how to defeat Chris. Then the stage collapses into a pool of Mountain Dew Baja Blast, and Steve ascends into a hologram labelled “Return when Fortnite ends.”

quote.text: Begin the Mixtape. Sync with the Flip Phone Covenant. And remember… never update

events.title: The Gawk-ination of 2039
events.text: When it is over, [[yuno-miles|Yuno Miles]] is the last rapper. He gains immortality.

events.title: The first Verse-Wide Tour
events.text: Yuno Miles gets a cult following and tours the universe. Gangs from all over buy tickets, and the tour cements him as a historically ass artist. That is why his music is still prominent even today.

events.title: MF Vroom's frat days
events.text: [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] gets his degree in business from [[darkworld-state-university|Darkworld State University]] and joins [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]] with his bestie [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]]. Part of the hazing is helping the higher-ups package [[xp-candy|XP candy]]. They make so much [[kromer]].

events.title: MF Vroom and Son bring O'Block to its glory
events.text: MF Vroom and his right-hand man [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]] build [[o-block|O'Block]] up until it has a whole nation around it. Their success is short-lived.

events.title: The O'Block Coup
events.text: [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], a frat member of [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] at [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]], shows up on Vroom's porch and demands that O'Block join the [[european-union|EU]]. Vroom declines, because the Projects are in the Americas, not Europe. The frat bros storm his palace and take complete control. Son is at his sister's wedding.

quote.text: If I were there everything would be different pogchamp.

events.title: TON 618 is built
events.text: At the beginning of the O'Block 2 era, Osama creates monolithically sized defensive bio-robotic weapons robots. The most infamous is [[ton-618|TON 618]] (Terrible Offensive Nuhuh), in [[dpf-facility-69420|facility 69420]].

events.title: Facebook (Pre-Cringe) is found
events.text: Under a building, in the rubble, someone finds [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]] on a [[microsd-card|67 GB micro SD card]]. It becomes one of the prize possessions of the [[projects-national-archives|national archives]]. Nobody is sure how it got there.

events.title: The Great Fortnite Island Wars
events.text: [[plankton|Plankton]] is a veteran.

events.title: Tim Apple retires
events.text: [[tim-apple|Tim Apple]] retires, and Steve Jobs has had to source all his gadgets locally ever since. The new kid can't be trusted, but he'll explain that later.

events.title: Hank, Jesse and Walter are teleported into Dusty Depot
events.text: Since then they haven't had an ounce of oil for their business. It has left them broke and big sad.

events.title: Steve from Minecraft and Quagmire go to the Projects
events.text: [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]] travel to the famed city of [[the-projects|the Projects]] to meet Osama Bin Bom'in and coordinate their attack. Their guide is [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], a long-lost relative of the [[projects-royal-family|Projects' royal family]], keen on returning to the top.

events.title: MF Vroom is exiled to the COD lobbies
events.text: At the heart of the Projects, the city of [[i-38-west|I-38 West]], Osama sends MF Vroom into exile, to forever get yelled at in [[call-of-duty-lobbies|COD lobbies]]. MF Vroom is never seen again. (He is seen again.)

events.title: The Attack on Moscow is planned
events.text: Osama, Steve and Quagmire agree to level Moscow to shut McDonald's up and let DQ win already. The [[toyota-corolla|Toyota Corolla]] for the initial bombing run is [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]], a [[chick-fil-a-loyalists|Chick-fil-A loyalist]] and a [[knights-of-4chan|knight of 4chan]]. His way out: [[tyler-from-uber|Tyler from Uber]].

events.title: Osama is ambushed by QXC and Jinxy
events.text: Leaving the Projects, Osama is ambushed by [[qxc|QXC]] and [[jinxy|Jinxy]]. Not knowing who they are, he ignores the mustard gas and leaves without injury.

events.title: The Attack on Moscow
events.text: The attack leaves Lightning McQueen “blasted”. Instead of leaving with Tyler from Uber, he moves in with [[george-constanta|George Constanta]].

events.title: Bon Jovi takes the Galactic Senate
events.text: [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]] takes the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]] on [[planet-patrick|the planet of Patrick]] in the [[uniontown-system|Uniontown system]]. The battle is long and hard, but he pushes out all of the 80-year-old senators. One remains: a Dark Knight named [[rfk|RFK]].

events.title: RFK's adoptive parents die at a Lil Uzi Vert concert
events.text: RFK only remembers it after the Senate is over. In the book it comes a chapter later; on the Timeline it goes where it happened.

events.title: The Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate
events.text: Bon Jovi looks around and proclaims “Nuh Uh”. “Yuh huh.” “Nuh Uh.” “Nuh Uh.” “Yuh huh.” This continues for the rest of Chapter 2.

quote.text: It’s over Bon Jovi I have 4 Red Bulls and a lightsaber, no one can mess with me I’m cool

events.title: Bon Jovi dies at the hands of RFK
events.text: RFK stands on the Senate floor and ponders his existence. Then he decides he has had enough, and leaves.

quote.text: why is RFK how is RFK, many are not pog like RFK

events.title: RFK meets Plankton
events.text: Walking the streets of [[chai-town|Chai Town]] with a [[g-fuel|G Fuel]], RFK is approached by [[plankton|Plankton]] (no last name, he's an orphan), who knows all about RFK's cool sad backstory and the [[lost-society-of-ballers|lost society of ballers]].

quote.text: His Name…. Is Chris: All balled up Deluxe Edition.

events.title: Chris is traced to the Reformed Travis Scott Sector
events.text: Plankton is getting traces of Chris in the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]], buying a McDouble on one of its planets. The only one who can battle him has met the tech bros and downloaded the sacred social media apps onto a [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500 flip phone]] with the [[verizon-contract|3 year contract plan from Verizon]].

events.title: The New Crips quest begins
events.text: RFK considers Mark Zuckerberg (his baller finger was just chill like that), then decides they're gonna enlist MF Vroom instead: restore him to power in the Projects and harness the power of the gang army. Vroom is at [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]], deep in the heart of [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]].

quote.text: Aight Bet

events.title: McQueen flies to England
events.text: Sick of George Constanta, Lightning McQueen flies from the Soviet Union to [[england|England]] to meet his contacts from [[parliament|Parliament]]. A [[the-pager|pager]] from a stranger tells him to hoard smoke detectors for “special reasons”. England has reached a new level of Roman.

events.title: The Goober Gang forms
events.text: At the [[smoke-and-vape-shop|smoke and vape shop]], [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] briefs McQueen while [[agent-007|Agent 007]] hits a fat vape in the telephone booth. The mission: take [[constantinople|Constantinople]] from the [[barack-empire|Barack Empire]] and restore [[bernie-sanders|Bernie Sanders]]. The plan: nukes, flood the city with oil, lure [[barack-obama|Obama]] (holder of the [[seven-chaos-emeralds|7 chaos emeralds]]) to the centre, then 6.8 seconds to escape through a wormhole that theoretically could open.

quote.text: McQueen.. Ive heard stories about your work in Moscow I think your a Dope pick for the mission

events.title: Hank Hill is cornered on the Twelve Towers
events.text: The [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]], an army divided by [[jeff-bezosi|Jeff Bezosi]] and Mark Zucc, corners [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] atop the [[twelve-towers|twelve towers]] in the [[kanye-system|Kanye system]] over his [[propane]] empire. They already have [[snoopy-mcspookintosh|Snoopy McSpookintosh]] in custody.

quote.text: If I were you id be counting my lucky stars because the wrath of Jesse and white be upon ye

events.title: The crack van exits hyperspace
events.text: BOOM. The [[crack-van|drug van from Breaking Bad]] drops out of hyperspace next to Hank. Floods of [[blue-dust|blue dust]] fall on the DOD, who flee in fear of being a [[goober]]. [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] and [[walter-white|White]] pick Hank up, and the goobers are gone.

events.title: The Weezing of Kanye
events.text: Their Twitter account doesn't have 100 followers yet, so the only way to get the ingredients from [[kanye-west|Kanye]] is to break into his house and weeze him. They do. The propane is watered down.

quote.text: This isn’t over kanye

events.title: The nukes are planted
events.text: Mr. Bean and 007 hide the first two nukes in bags of old pagers. 007 loses his torso (he could be fine), and [[putin|Putin]] lectures Bean about mental illness. McQueen plants the third at the [[abandoned-walmarts|abandoned Walmarts]], declining the [[local-mafia|local mafia]]'s request to be part of society, and the fourth at a Walmart that is now a [[popeyes|Popeyes]], after ordering at gunpoint.

quote.text: Can I get two number 9s, a number 9 large a number 6 with extra DIEP a number 7 two number 45’s, one with cheese, and a large soda

events.title: The Fall of Constantinople
events.text: McQueen picks up Bean and 007 at [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]]. They fly past [[dababy|DaBaby]], vaporized in a suspended animation cell, and into the [[the-wormhole|wormhole]]. Constantinople falls at 14:74pm [[unc-standard-time|Unc Standard Time]], and that is the last anyone hears from the Goober Gang. For now.

events.title: Ye the Gas
events.text: In the [[united-streets-of-ohio|United Streets of Ohio]], Kanye and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] find a [[corner-store-ohio|corner store]] that sells potato chips for 2.85 a gallon, where all the crips will buy their gas. Kanye plans a song to promote his new propane brand, [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]].

quote.text: Of course sir, anyone will buy your product for your are *baller*

events.title: RFK and Plankton reach Dunder Mifflan
events.text: After a month-long trip in their underpowered [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]], boosted 40% by [[galaxy-gas|galaxy gas]] from [[litl-wayne|Litl Wayne]], they reach a galaxy encapsulated in a giant Dunder Mifflin office building, guarded by [[google-smart-guards|Google Smart guards]]. They slip in behind [[the-sign|the sign]].

quote.text: Dear god.. its huge there’s so much.. paper..

events.title: Into the vending machine Labyrinth
events.text: The ship finds Call of Duty in the lobby [[file-cabinet|file cabinet]]: aisle 3 of the vending machine section. It flies through the crack in the door of the machine, into the [[vending-machine-labyrinth|Labyrinth]], and lands at [[cod-hq|COD HQ]] in a very dark heavy storm.

events.title: Larry the Cucumber is killed on 21 Jump Street
events.text: [[larry-the-cucumber|Larry the Cucumber]] gets killed on [[21-jump-street|21 Jump Street]]. The book mentions this in brackets and never again.

events.title: Ioannus Paranukus joins the party
events.text: A man smashes through the extremely [[openable-door|OpenAble Door]]: [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius Nukian]], Jedi master and dealer of justice. He is of the Projects, and wishes to free his king. The party of three ventures into COD HQ.

quote.text: I Am Ioann-ius Nukian Jedi master and dealer of justice (I sell per gram, $40 a gram)

events.title: The battle in the Xbox Live dungeons
events.text: Inside is madness: Pokémon everywhere, gamers yelled at for not capping red, Xbox 360s red-ringing in the middle of COD tournaments. Ioannus jumps into the battle with his white lightsaber and disappears into the red mist. RFK and Plankton run for the [[chambers-360|360 chambers]].

events.title: Kanye and ChatGPT roll into Gotham
events.text: Kanye parks the [[prius-of-destiny|Prius of Destiny]] next to [[ye-olde-bin|Ye Olde Bin]] in [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]. [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]], App Whisperer, hands them a USB stick labelled [[zuck-tears-usb|‘Zuck Tears (Do Not Install)’]], tells them to run it on stage, and vapes into a drain.

quote.text: Sir, statistically 98.7% of Gotham is built from darkness, broken dreams, and Tim Burton's college notebooks.

events.title: Drake Batman asks for help
events.text: [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]], in Ugg boots, has been watching Kanye on the Ring camera. The Joker, [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]], has started a SoundCloud, and his mixtape [[laugh-exe|Laugh.exe]] is infecting Gotham's infrastructure through [[bluetooth-gargoyles|Bluetooth-enabled gargoyles]].

quote.text: Gotham needs your help. The Joker’s started a SoundCloud.

events.title: The Battle of Club Shadowban
events.text: At [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], beneath a giant Twitter X suspended by Elon's tears, Kanye and ChatGPT drop their mixtape, [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]]. Lil Jokez morphs into a 2007 JPEG of Heath Ledger, and Drake Batman tackles him into a [[meme-portal|meme portal]]. The mixtape has dropped.

quote.text: I’m Ye the Gas, no watered-down trash, My bars melt steel beams, while you still DoorDash.

events.title: Steve Jobs arrives on a sideways iPhone 3G
events.text: Across all multiverses a wormhole opens. Out of it flies a glowing sideways [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]], with Steve Jobs standing on top. He lifts it like Mufasa presenting Simba, and apps begin downloading themselves onto flip phones across the cosmos. The Shadow Realm weeps.

quote.text: One more thing… Let’s end this.

events.title: Club Shadowban has been sent to the Shadow Realm
events.text: Everybody else has vanished. The club looks abandoned for years, with only the outlines of everybody's feet left in the dust. Something happened with that USB drive. Steve asks Siri to locate the Inav.

quote.text: Honestly this is not pogchamp lets be real

events.title: The Inav lands in Gotham
events.text: A white, pill-shaped multiverse navigator with a teal glass shell lands in front of them. Outside it is the size of a phone booth; inside it is a mansion. Siri serves Kanye an ice-cold [[diet-dr-pepper|Diet Dr Pepper]]. Gotham is disappearing, because beat drops can't exist without balling, so Steve sets course for the Casino to liberate the gift card.

quote.text: Welcome to Inav, a multiverse navigator that just works.

events.title: Out of propane in Dusty Depot
events.text: The RV of time is damaged, and the oil has run out. Jesse goes through a port-a-potty to the [[quick-check|Quick-Check]] for Doritos and hears about an oil casino nearby. Hank has some mysterious apes on his bitcoin wallet. Walter dreams of a Mountain Dew refinery and restaurant called [[erger-wings|Erger Wings]].

quote.text: Gosh dang it Jesse boy, we ran out of propane

events.title: The Great Roulette Bet
events.text: Through the [[port-a-potty-portal|port-a-potty portal]] and into [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]]. After a marathon to the roulette room, and an entire 4 minutes, they have a bet in. It is a heart-wrenching experience, but they prevail.

quote.text: Several NFTs on red!

events.title: Microsoft Bing hires security
events.text: The ball is stopped by a large robot with a giant TV for a body: [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]]. A group that includes [[bings-son|his son]] intends to steal the casino's ancient relic, which creates a [[field-of-gambling|field of gambling]] around any building. The price for guarding it: 15 gallons of his finest Prime US [[oil]]. Then down the [[stairway-to-heaven|stairway to heaven]].

events.title: The night watch over the Verizon contract
events.text: The relic is [[verizon-contract|the 3 year contract plan from Verizon for unlimited talk and text]], recovered from the ruins of the [[la-walmart|LA Walmart]]. The gang lights a fire in front of the vault door, slams their [[red-bull|Red Bulls]] and nods off, in no fear, since their scars are gold.

events.title: The Inav reaches Sector 1/99
events.text: The Inav bursts out of the wormhole above the casino in [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]], the gambling addiction sector, once home to Elon Mush, Frodo Baggins and [[d-piddy|D. Piddy]]. If they can get the gift card, they will have started the journey to [[the-court|the court]].

quote.text: Woah bruh this place be bussin’ for real on Geoffrey

events.title: The FaceTime laser
events.text: [[the-boys|The boys]] sneak out of the Inav blasting Yuno Miles in their Earpods Pro .5's. ChatGPT plugs into Steve's iPhone and turns on the [[facetime-laser|ultra mega uber cool FaceTime laser]], which cuts an entrance into the pale beige brick of the casino wall.

events.title: The Charlie Kirks
events.text: In the lower chambers, Kanye opens a door onto 3–4 [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]], trained warriors defending the gift card. Steve Jobs leaps onto the first with his [[igun|Igun]]. The others take out their [[t1-phones|T1 phones]] and open Truth Social. Alarms start to blare.

quote.text: Alright boys, its time to count gang violence.

events.title: Bring out the lobster
events.text: The alarms wake Hank, Jesse and Mr. White. White runs for the hallway, but security has its own plan: [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]] jumps out with his DJ set and lays down a sick beat. Kanye jumps at him. DJ Khaled dodges it, no problem.

quote.text: Hank let the security guard deal with this.. BRING OUT THE LOBSTER!!

events.title: The two gangs make peace
events.text: Jesse recognises Ye. The fighting stops. If Chris were defeated there would be plenty of oil reserves, less regulation, and in addition, balling would be free. The two gangs sit in silence, then team up.

quote.text: and in addition.. balling would be free.

events.title: The Ibeam opens the vault
events.text: Steve places an [[airtag|AirTag]] on the vault door so the Inav can lock on and fire the [[ibeam|Ibeam]]. First an EMP, then DJ Khaled gets a massive low taper fade, then an enormous beam shoots through the building. Inside [[the-vault|the vault]], glowing with a radiant golden light: the 3 year contract plan from Verizon.

quote.text: Hey Siri.. fire the Ibeam.

events.title: Escape to the TurboGrafx 16 Sector
events.text: Kanye puts the gift card in his Yeezy jacket. They climb into the Inav as Charlie Kirks pour out of the stairwell, the bullets bouncing off its white glassy hull, and teleport to the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 Sector]].

events.title: The 5G problem
events.text: They need to sync with the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]], but it uses [[5g|5G]], and connecting the iPhone to 5G means Elon Mush. The plan: load a social media app first and roll back to 3G right when they're in Chris's face. GPT points out they will have to deal with Elon at the same time as Chris. “So what’s the plan Jawbs?” Steve repeats it, and the answer is that they will be fighting “Elon musk, mush, and the sole nba player of the universe”.

quote.text: Load the socials, then went we’re in his face, connect to the covenant and roll back from 5g to…. 3G.

events.title: MF Vroom is found in the 360 chambers
events.text: In the silent [[chambers-360|360 chambers]], lined with pipes of [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dew]], Ioannus draws his lightsaber, RFK his [[hantavirus-vaccine|hantavirus vaccine]], Plankton his [[metal-folding-chair|metal folding chair]]. From the shadows leaps a car wearing a robe. It is MF Vroom, who escaped the COD lobbies and has been lost in the hallways for days.

quote.text: Bruh just leave

events.title: The way out of COD HQ
events.text: A door appears, smothered in Dorito dust and Mountain Dew oil. Outside it is raining Pepsi and Dew. They find the System Cruiser, unweathered, and take off. They never do find the USB port.

quote.text: Obama care did not reach this door

events.title: A call from Spamton
events.text: On the way to the Projects, MF Vroom's [[windows-phone|Windows phone]] rings ([[peter-griffin-ringtone|Peter Griffin singing some choir something]]). It's Spamton, who wants intergalactic road kill for a new recipe [[grogu|Grogu]] told him about, and says to pop up to [[cyber-city|Cyber City]].

quote.text: pop up to [CYBERR1!! C1TYY!!] When you get there chance

events.title: Out of hyperspace over Adirondack Park
events.text: A goose on the windshield, leaves on the wings, and the brisk breeze of a New York morning over [[adirondack-park|Adirondack Park]]. A slow turn at Mach 3 lines them up with the [[projects-national-spaceport|Projects national spaceport]].

events.title: Son S. Sonionring returns
events.text: [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]], Osama's ambassador, moves to arrest MF Vroom. A dark figure from the janitorial staff cocks a [[modded-colonial-musket|modded colonial musket]] and shoots Triple T through his wooden body. It is Son, Vroom's right-hand man, back from hiding.

quote.text: GG fricken easy

events.title: The Spaceport Breakout & O'Block Chase
events.text: Straight through spaceport security, muskets firing, lightsabers slicing. In Son's [[honda-accord-2005|2005 Honda Accord]], chased by [[police-kirks|police Kirks]] who transform into police cars, a machine gun from the trunk fires [[purple-juice|solidified purple juice]] and pops every tire, to [[i-cant-put-down-the-cup|“I Can't Put Down the Cup”]].

events.title: TON 618 wakes up
events.text: A faint blue glow in one of the giant defensive processing facilities. Plankton, out of instinct from the Fortnite Island Wars, starts chanting. Then a giant robotic roar is heard from horizon to horizon. Osama does not want them here.

quote.text: Hey uh guys, did ninja aka Tyler Blevins join this Fortnite lobby.

events.title: The Prophecy is told
events.text: MF Vroom tells them [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]: one whose phone holds MySpace v1.3.3, Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition, Facebook (Pre-Cringe), Twitter Bluebird Variant, Apple Podcasts 2, Settings (Full access) and the 3 year contract plan from Verizon will beat Chris on the court, their team filled with [[determination|DETERMINATION]].

quote.text: and Chris will fall, but only if despite everything, on the court, its still you.

events.title: Computah, locate Facebook…
events.text: They can't take back the Projects with TON 618 hunting them, but they could just get Facebook (Pre-Cringe) from the palace. It's [[chicken-hour|chicken hour]], so the guards won't be looking. The skies turn orange, and their course is set.

quote.text: Aight bet

events.title: The horizon of Gex covers
events.text: [[steve-jobs|Steve]] has [[siri|Siri]] roll down the window of the [[inav|Inav]] and pulls in a cover of [[gex-enter-the-gecko|Gex: Enter the Gecko]] from an endless storm of box art. He explains the universe to [[kanye-west|Kanye]], who becomes visibly tweaked out at the blue border at the edge of his sight.

quote.text: Its like im surrounded by some big blue border n-

events.title: The Ultra Hand takes the Inav
events.text: “Hey siri lets delta out of here.” A giant [[ultra-hand|Ultra Hand]] appears from the abyss and wraps its fingers round the Inav, yanking it through time and space.

quote.text: It seems we’re being forcefully taken onto a episode of throats for thought.

events.title: Throats For Thought
events.text: The Inav lands in a recording studio. [[hector-andfriends|Hector Andfriends]] seats the heroes on the set of [[throats-for-thought|Throats For Thought]] and asks why one of them has no throat. [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] has a mechanical one.

events.title: The Madden NFL 08 Argument
events.text: Asked whether they would play Madden NFL 08 on Wii, the gang argues with Mr. Andfriends for a full 2 hours and 4 minutes.

events.title: Scott the Woz bursts in
events.text: Out of breath and in a panic, [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] reports that the Border is changing colour: first black, then “A giant Bezel.” Chris has turned him against Apple products and he cannot play Wii Fit. He offers a ride in his ship. [[officer-steelwool|Officer Steelwool]], he says, may know where Snapchat is.

quote.text: I usually buy apple products but Chris has turned that against me! HOW WILL I PLAY WII FIT!

events.title: The Wii cube
events.text: They run past the Target and the GameStop to [[scotts-house|Scott's house]], where a giant box made of Wii games waits in the backyard. Scott phones [[the-wozniaks|his gang]]. Two hours and a trip to Sheetz later, they are aboard the [[wii-cube|Wii cube]].

events.title: Two roadsters from Elon
events.text: [[jerry-attricks|Jerry Attricks]] asks why Kanye West is here. Scott has two [[tesla-roadsters-2028|2028 Tesla roadsters]] on the way from Elon Musk, whom he texts. Soon the border is in view, and the roadsters dock.

quote.text: It’s Ye

events.title: Spamton NEO
events.text: Inside the [[the-border|Border]]: darkness, a clank and pulleys, then [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]]. iGrenades are teleported away, Kanye drops bars, Hank and Jesse shoot. [[jerry-jab|Jerry Jab]] has left his Wii zapper at home, and a Kromer brick knocks Scott flat.

quote.text: I AM SECRET BOSS, IN DELTARUNE GAME

events.title: Awesome, baby
events.text: Scott slams [[dick-vitales-awesome-baby|Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby]] into a Sega Genesis. Spamton NEO is ripped from his strings, a basketball echoes out of the building, and the Border turns blue again to the Scott the Woz motif. The real Spamton remembers nothing.

quote.text: SPAMTON NEO got ripped from his strings and a lone SPAMTON rested on the ground.

events.title: Officer Steelwool's message
events.text: Scott calls [[officer-steelwool|Officer Steelwool]], who plays a recorded Night 1 welcome message. Conclusion: Snapchat: Ghost Protocol is in [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]].

quote.text: Well that solves it, Snapchat: Ghost protcol is in.. Freddy Fazbears Pizza

events.title: The Basement Deal
events.text: [[walter-white|Walter]] asks [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] if he can set up shop in his basement. Scott agrees, if Walter plays Wii Sports with Moh on Thursdays. Walter and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] fly to Ohio with the Wii box.

quote.text: Sounds like a deal yo

events.title: 69,420 Kromer
events.text: [[hank-hill|Hank]] is left behind: “Damn son they done left us like that?!” In the last roadster, Spamton offers Kromer for the road, [[steve-jobs|Steve's]] phone buzzes for 69,420 [[kromer|Kromer]] ($20 USD), and the salesman is gone.

events.title: To the New Jersey system
events.text: Steve announces the next stop. The next chapter, [[chapter-new-jersey]], has so far only a title.

quote.text: Alright boys, its time to go to the New Jersey system
